summary: A standing lattice-tower fire lookout in Grainger County, Tennessee, with almost no documented history beyond its existence and location.

corrections.evidence: OpenStreetMap way 909749289 tags the structure tower:construction=lattice, tower:type=observation.

notes_for_editor: No register page exists for Avondale on nhlr.org or firetower.org (checked cached TN listings for both; it isn't there), no NRHP nomination, no newspaper hit, and no mention in a general East Tennessee fire-tower news piece that was checked. Web search surfaced an AI-synthesized claim that Avondale is 'also known as Clinch Lookout Tower,' but no primary source for that name turned up (anyplaceamerica.com, the likely origin, returned 403) so it was left out rather than guessed into the story. Builder, year built, agency, staffing and access all remain unknown; a human with access to TN Division of Forestry records or local Grainger County history might find more.
